definition: [ תָּקַן ] verb become straight (Late Hebrew תִּקֵּן arrange, put right ; Eccl 47:9 תיקן set in order ; Assyrian takânu , be well ordered , especially Pi`el as Late Hebrew; Aramaic be established, firm , Pa`el , תֵּקֵּין fix, arrange, prepare , etc.; Palmyrene Pa`el erect ); — Qal Infinitive construct לִתְקֹן Eccl 1:15 (opposed to מְעֻוָּת bent ). Pi`el Infinitive construct לְתַקֵּן Eccl 7:13 make straight (opposed to עִוָּה ); Perfect 3 masculine singular תִּקֵּן Eccl 12:9 put straight, arrange in order (proverbs).

Qal Infinitive construct לִתְקֹן Eccl 1:15 (opposed to מְעֻוָּת bent). Pi`el Infinitive construct לְתַקֵּן Eccl 7:13 make straight (opposed to עִוָּה); Perfect 3 masculine singular תִּקֵּן Eccl 12:9 put straight, arrange in order (proverbs).
